activeQuestion.prompt: What does IT advise users to avoid?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 資訊部建議使用者避免什麼？

options.text: Reading any email on Sunday evening
options.zh: 星期日晚上讀取任何郵件
options.whyZh: 郵件仍可使用，文件未禁止。

options.text: Editing local copies of shared spreadsheets during the outage
options.zh: 維護期間編輯共用試算表的本機副本
options.whyZh: 通知擔心不同版本產生衝突。

options.zh: 晚上九點四十五分前下載檔案
options.whyZh: 這正是資訊部建議採取的準備。

options.text: Uploading an unchanged approved PDF to the portal
options.zh: 上傳未修改的核准 PDF 至入口網站
options.whyZh: 對話明確建議以此方式按時交件。

group.title: Shared-drive maintenance
group.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — IT notice
The shared drive will be offline on Sunday from 10 p.m. to 11:30 p.m. while storage hardware is replaced. Email, the customer portal, and VPN login will remain available. A working VPN connection will not make the shared drive accessible during the outage.
Download any files you need before 9:45 p.m. Avoid editing local copies of shared spreadsheets during the outage; conflicting versions may result. The drive will reopen in read-only mode first, and IT will announce when normal editing is restored.

DOCUMENT 2 — Team chat, Sunday 8:40 p.m.
Nina: I must upload the approved quotation to the customer portal by 11 p.m. The final PDF is on the shared drive. Can I still meet the deadline?
Owen: Yes. Copy the final PDF to your laptop now. The portal is not included in the outage. Do not modify the PDF; the customer must receive the approved version.
group.passageZh:
文件一——資訊部通知
星期日晚上十點至十一點半，因更換儲存硬體，共用磁碟將離線。電子郵件、客戶入口網站及 VPN 登入仍可使用。維護期間，即使 VPN 連線正常，也無法存取共用磁碟。
請在晚上九點四十五分前下載需要的檔案。維護期間避免編輯共用試算表的本機副本，否則可能產生版本衝突。磁碟會先以唯讀模式恢復，資訊部會另外公告何時恢復正常編輯。

文件二——星期日晚上八點四十分團隊對話
Nina：我最遲須在晚上十一點把已核准報價上傳到客戶入口網站。最終 PDF 在共用磁碟，我還能趕上期限嗎？
Owen：可以，現在就把最終 PDF 複製到筆電。入口網站不在停機範圍內。不要修改 PDF，客戶必須收到核准版本。
